title: Design System: Structural Bioinformatics Research Atlas

display.purpose: Compact page title; narrow-screen size is documented in Layout and Typography.

headline.purpose: Research sections and document chapter hierarchy.

body.purpose: Inherited Arad baseline with generous research-page line height.

reader-body.purpose: Repository Markdown paragraphs and lists bounded to a reading column.

label.purpose: Small labels, metadata and status annotations.

control.purpose: Compact button text; individual selectors retain local sizes.

tab.purpose: Wrapped navigation labels with heavier selected state.

sequence.purpose: LTR monospace source material with tabular numerals.

motion.name: control-fill
motion.purpose: Utility and tab hover treatment; no button movement.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Research-page override when reduced motion is requested.

motion.name: camera-rotation
motion.purpose: Optional Three.js camera rotation; paused when hidden or reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Utility Button
components.description: Quiet utility action used by the laboratory, sequences and chapter controls.

components.name: Pressed Toggle
components.description: Pressed state for camera rotation or interface visibility; availability remains explicit.

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Labeled search field from the optional source catalog.

components.name: Structure Selector
components.description: Actual experimental-structure choices, with the optional comparison lane labeled.

components.name: Six-Tab Research Navigation
components.description: Sticky index with selected, hover and focus states; all six tabs stay visible on phones.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:var(--bg,#f5f5f7);border-bottom:1px solid #bfcbe0}.ds-tab{font-family:"arad", system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:0;min-height:40px;padding:13px 15px 11px;border:0;border-radius:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:#445773;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:580;line-height:1.75;white-space:normal;text-wrap:balance;cursor:pointer;transition:background 150ms ease}.ds-tab:hover{background:#eaf0fb;color:#17489e;transform:none}.ds-tab[aria-selected="true"]{color:#164cad;font-weight:720;border-bottom-color:var(--accent,#2563eb);background:#edf2fc}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#2563eb);outline-offset:-4px}@media(max-width:800px){.ds-tabs{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.ds-tab{padding-inline:12px;font-size:.83rem}}@media(max-width:560px){.ds-tabs{gap:0}.ds-tab{font-size:.79rem;padding:12px 5px 10px;min-height:48px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tab{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
The implemented surface extends the portfolio's Arad typography, light neutral field and blue actions. It reads as a Persian research booklet: prose, scientific figures and fine separators carry the hierarchy, with small rounded controls where the reader can operate a view or choose a document.

The reading experience stays calm while the laboratory gives experimental geometry room to be inspected. Source links, captions, units and limitations stay adjacent to the material they explain. These are instructional conventions for this research surface; molecular colors and evidence types do not define a new site-wide brand.

**Key Characteristics:
keyCharacteristics: Real Arad Persian typography with generous reading line height.
Persian RTL composition with isolated Latin identifiers, sequences and mathematics.
Blue actions and selected states on a light neutral field.
Flat reading sections, fine separators and restrained rounded controls.
Scientific media accompanied by source, representation and interpretation limits.

rules.name: The Action Blue Rule
rules.body: Use blue to identify links, controls, selection and focus. Scientific chain colors keep their own source-specific meaning.

rules.name: The Isolated Identifier Rule
rules.body: Keep Persian explanations RTL and wrap Latin identifiers with `bdi`. Sequences, code, coordinate values and mathematics retain their explicit LTR direction.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Use document flow and separators for reading material. Keep interface depth restrained; molecular lighting represents the scientific view rather than a reusable card effect.

dos: Do use the existing Arad asset for Persian headings, prose and controls.
Do retain Persian RTL layout and isolate Latin identifiers, code, sequences and mathematics.
Do use blue interaction states and a visible keyboard focus outline.
Do use fine separators and reading columns before adding another container.
Do keep all six tabs visible on phones and allow wide scientific content to scroll within its own region.
Do keep scientific figures near their captions, source links, units and interpretation limits.
Do retain readable source or static fallback material when optional rendering is unavailable.
donts: Don't replace the established Paper-like reading direction or the Arad identity with a new visual brand.
Don't treat molecular chain colors as global interface accents or universal biological categories.
Don't move source identifiers or caveats away from the scientific material they explain.
Don't turn local failures into an unusable whole-page state.
Don't add compulsory camera animation or preserve transitions under reduced motion.
